title: 第003章 天帝诀第004章 灵阁遇齐家
content_zh:
这让齐刀一怔：“的确如此，我记得你今年十六岁吧？怎么？叶炎，你也要参加吗？哈哈哈！”
叶炎凝神，他也知晓这苍云圣碑的规矩。
名在其上，家族一门荣耀。其他人，不可随意而动。
云飞雪虽是圣人，但也有所顾忌。
因为那苍云圣碑，乃是六百年前一位圣人所立。
那是万炎帝国建国以来，苍云城唯一走出的一位圣人，他名为苍云，城池便以其名而立。
至于城主府，更由苍家世代接管。
如今，他们竟是随意更改了规矩？而且还想要抹掉自己父亲的名字？
哼！
叶炎冷嗤一声，云飞雪之名也在其上，这等之人竟也与父亲同在一块石碑之上，让叶炎恶心到了极点，这是对父亲的玷污！
既如此，那叶炎便亲手将云飞雪之名抹掉！
“我当然要参加！”叶炎道。
一声落下，四方惊愕。
“哈……哈哈哈！”
齐刀以及齐家的修炼者，顿时大笑起来。
叶炎也要参加？
他，乃是真正的废人！
至今，未曾修炼，不过凡人而已。
虽有几分傲骨，但面对着云飞雪却已被重伤了经脉骨骼，能够活下来，便是万幸。
还想要参见苍云战？

“难道，你也想夺魁不成？”齐刀更是讥讽一笑，“不过也好，若你参加，整个苍云城甚至是整个万炎帝国的人都会观看吧？那一刻，所有人都将见证我儿齐山荣登荣耀之位，名留苍云圣碑之上。”
而且，如此之下，苍云战内也好名正言顺的将叶炎斩杀。
苍云战可拳脚无眼，死个人也在情理之中！
这不算是破坏规矩！
若齐山能够将叶炎斩杀，在云家那里，绝对是大功一件。
而且，苍云圣碑上能够将叶啸天名字抹掉，那……叶家将再不受庇护！
那时，便是叶家灭亡之日。
齐家，必定跟随云家成为整个万炎帝国无上尊荣之族。
“叶炎，一月之后，苍云战上，我等着你！”这一刻，齐山目光内闪烁着阴冷，更夹杂着浓浓的讥讽之色。
“我们走！”齐刀开口，旋即齐家之人离开。
“炎儿，你……太冲动了！苍云战，岂是那般简单？”叶龙盯着叶炎，有着担忧之色。
content_en:
This made Qi Dao startled: "That's true. I remember you are sixteen years old this year, right? What? Ye Yan, do you want to participate too? Hahaha!"
Ye Yan concentrated, he also knew the rules of this Cangyun Holy Monument.
With its name on it, the family is honored. Others cannot move at will.
Although Yun Feixue is a saint, he still has some scruples.
Because the Cangyun Holy Monument was erected by a saint six hundred years ago.
That was the only saint who emerged from Cangyun City since the founding of the Wanyan Empire. His name was Cangyun, and the city was built in his name.
As for the City Lord's Mansion, it has been taken over by the Cang family for generations.
Now, they have changed the rules at will? And you want to erase your father’s name?
snort!
Ye Yan sneered coldly. Yun Feixue's name was also on it. People like him were actually on the same stone tablet as his father. Ye Yan was disgusted to the extreme. This was a stain on his father!
In this case, Ye Yan would personally erase Yun Feixue's name!
"Of course I want to participate!" Ye Yan said.
A sound fell, and everyone was shocked.
"Ha...hahaha!"
Qi Dao and the practitioners of the Qi family burst into laughter.
Ye Yan also wants to participate?
He is a real loser!
So far, I have never practiced, I am just a mortal.
Although he was somewhat arrogant, facing Yun Feixue, his meridians and bones had been seriously injured. He was lucky to survive.
Still want to see Cangyun Zhan?
"Do you also want to win the first prize?" Qi Dao even smiled sarcastically, "But it's okay, if you participate, the entire Cangyun City and even the entire Wanyan Empire will watch, right? At that moment, everyone will witness that my son Qishan ascends to the position of glory, and his name will be left on the Cangyun Holy Monument."
Moreover, under this condition, Cangyun Zhannii could justifiably kill Ye Yan.
Cangyun Zhanke has no fists and no eyes, so it is reasonable for someone to die!
This is not breaking the rules!
If Qi Shan can kill Ye Yan, it will definitely be a great achievement for the Yun family.
Moreover, if Ye Xiaotian's name can be erased from the Cangyun Holy Monument, then... the Ye family will no longer be protected!
At that time, it was the day when the Ye family perished.
The Qi family will definitely follow the Yun family and become the most honorable family in the entire Wanyan Empire.
"Ye Yan, one month from now, we will fight Cangyun, I'll be waiting for you!" At this moment, Qi Shan's eyes flashed with coldness, mixed with a strong sense of sarcasm.
"Let's go!" Qi Dao said, and immediately the Qi family members left.
"Yan'er, you... are too impulsive! Can Cangyun Zhan be that simple?" Ye Long stared at Ye Yan with a worried expression.
